Live Reporting

Charlotte Coates

  1. HITS THE WOODWORKpublished at 90+10 mins
    90+10 mins

    Uzbekistan 1-3 Colombia

    Goodness me!

    Bekhruz Karimov absolutely thunders one off the crossbar. Almost snapped it in half.

    Share page
    About sharing

  2. GOAL - Uzbekistan 1-3 Colombiapublished at 04:59 BST
    04:59 BST

    Jaminton Campaz (90+9 mins)

    Game over!

    A really brilliant noise in this stadium as Jaminton Campaz plants his header low into the bottom corner and the three points are secure.

    But that goal doesn't happen if it's not for Cucho Hernandez's hard work down the right and his pinpoint cross.

    Share page
    About sharing

  3. Postpublished at 90+8 mins
    90+8 mins

    Uzbekistan 1-2 Colombia

    Nope. It's really poor again.

    Share page
    About sharing

  4. Postpublished at 90+7 mins
    90+7 mins

    Uzbekistan 1-2 Colombia

    And now Uzbekistan have a free-kick.

    Can they finally get that delivery right?

    Share page
    About sharing

  5. 'Cannot keep giving encouragement to a team that has got nothing to lose'published at 04:57 BST
    04:57 BST

    Uzbekistan 1-2 Colombia

    James McFadden
    Former Scotland forward on BBC One at the Mexico City Stadium

    There's no way Colombia should be facing this kind of pressure.

    You cannot keep giving encouragement to a team that has got nothing to lose.

    I'm sure they will be frustrated as a team that they have not been able to keep control of the game because the game was done.

    Share page
    About sharing

  6. Postpublished at 90+6 mins
    90+6 mins

    Uzbekistan 1-2 Colombia

    Two minutes to go and still Uzbekistan come forward.

    Share page
    About sharing

  7. Postpublished at 90+6 mins
    90+6 mins

    Uzbekistan 1-2 Colombia

    Uzbekistan may well go on to lose here but they can take plenty of positives from this second half.

    It's been chalk and cheese from the first.

    Share page
    About sharing

  8. SUBSTITUTIONSpublished at 90+5 mins
    90+5 mins

    Uzbekistan 1-2 Colombia

    Changes for both sides as Luis Diaz makes way for Andres Gomez.

    For Uzbekistan, Eldor Shomurodov is replaced by Igor Sergeev.

    Share page
    About sharing

  9. 'Mozgovoy will be disappointed'published at 04:54 BST
    04:54 BST

    Uzbekistan 1-2 Colombia

    James McFadden
    Former Scotland forward on BBC One at the Mexico City Stadium

    That's a big opportunity for Akmal Mozgovoy.

    He'll be disappointed he hasn't hit the target from there.

    Uzbekistan look like they believe they can go and get an equaliser.

    Share page
    About sharing

  10. Postpublished at 90+4 mins
    90+4 mins

    Uzbekistan 1-2 Colombia

    Farrukh Sayfiev sends in a really dangerous low cross from the left and it almost finds Eldor Shomurodov at the far post but Colombia do enough.

    Share page
    About sharing

  11. INJURY TIMEpublished at 90+2 mins
    90+2 mins

    Uzbekistan 1-2 Colombia

    We're into eight minutes of added time at the end of this one.

    Uzbekistan have Colombia pegged back.

    Share page
    About sharing

  12. CLOSE!published at 90+2 mins
    90+2 mins

    Uzbekistan 1-2 Colombia

    More tidy play from Uzbekistan opens up an opportunity for a shot.

    It's Akmal Mozgovoy who it opens up for just inside the box but he can't hit the target.

    Chance!

    Share page
    About sharing

  13. Postpublished at 90 mins
    90 mins

    Uzbekistan 1-2 Colombia

    Too much on the corner once again and it sails behind for a goal-kick.

    Uzbekistan just haven't got that delivery right at all tonight.

    Defenders finish, that.
